    The primitive torsion radical #

    For a primitive idempotent e, the Hoshino torsion radical sends a right A-module M to its largest submodule annihilated by AeA. In the right-module convention this is the idempotent-torsion submodule for MulOpposite.op e in the left Aᵐᵒᵖ-module M.
